key.name: panel-autohide
key.description: Slide the top bar out of view and bring it back when the pointer pushes against the top edge. Replaces panel-hover-fullscreen.

key.name: panel-autohide-fullscreen-only
key.description: Keep the top bar (and its space) as usual and hide it only while a fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: panel-autohide-reveal-delay
key.description: How long the pointer must stay pushed against the top edge before the top bar slides in.

key.name: panel-autohide-hide-delay
key.description: How long after the pointer leaves the top bar, and nothing holds it open, before it slides out.

key.name: panel-autohide-keep-on-desktop
key.summary: Keep the top bar on an empty desktop
key.description: Do not hide the top bar while no window is showing on the primary monitor.
